## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Review impact

- [ ] Security boundary or permission behavior changed
- [ ] Executable capability metadata changed
- [ ] Model, checksum, license, or download source changed
- [ ] Supported platform or architecture changed
- [ ] Binary package or document format changed
- [ ] WASM API, browser worker, cache, or download behavior changed
- [ ] Plugin API, ABI/IPC, isolation, or trust behavior changed

For every checked item, name the relevant owner and the threat/compatibility
assumption reviewers should verify.

## Fidelity and compatibility

State whether package validity, semantic preservation, layout preservation,
visual fidelity, editability, or round-trip fidelity changes. List expected loss.

## Verification

List exact commands and environments used. Include Chrome/Firefox, process-plugin
termination, production-model, fuzz, and scheduled-workflow results when applicable.

## Release classification

- [ ] RC-ready
- [ ] GA blocker addressed
- [ ] Optional future enhancement
- [ ] Known limitation documented
